keyMappings:
# Close tab with "q", restore with "Q"
unmap x
unmap X
map q removeTab
map Q restoreTab

# Switch J and K
map J nextTab
map K previousTab
searchEngines:
# Translate
dl: https://www.deepl.com/translator#fi/en/%s DeepL
gt: https://translate.google.com/?sl=fi&tl=en&text=%s&op=translate Google translate

# Search
s: https://search.coditon.com/search?q=%s SearXNG
g: https://www.google.com/search?q=%s Google
d: https://duckduckgo.com/?q=%s DuckDuckGo

# Git
ghn: https://github.com/search?q=language%3Anix+%s&type=code GitHub Nix
ghc: https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=code GitHub Code
ghu: https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=users GitHub Users
ghr: https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=repositories GitHub Repo

# Languages
rs: https://crates.io/search?q=%s Crates
js: https://www.npmjs.com/search?q=%s Node
py: https://pypi.org/search/?q=%s PyPi

# Nix
no: https://search.nixos.org/options?channel=unstable&query=%s NixOS Options
np: https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=unstable&query=%s NixOS Packages
hm: https://home-manager-options.extranix.com/?query=%s Home Manager Options

# Other
yt: https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%s Youtube
gm: https://www.google.com/maps?q=%s Google maps
